system.summary: Numerical nomenclator, values 1-845 so far, mixing letters, syllables and whole words (and place names with their article: 428 = la Guadeloupe); the same code in 1778 and 1779 (Bouillé). Not the 1761 Windward Islands code (max 696) and not the 1765 d'Ennery form.
system.sibling_key: C8 A 78 f. 123 (no. 363, 11 Oct 1779), same code with interlinear decipherment

prior_solution.where: Brice Dudout (Europe chiffrée) read C8 A 77 f. 88 and f. 101 on 28 Oct 2026 with a key (K6, 490 values) rebuilt from the same 1779 glosses; the project's page bouille1778. His key used f. 70 (no. 415) only as a held-out check; no reading of f. 70, f. 19 or f. 114 was found.

conditions.human_role: Assigned the target with the instruction to test the mercier1761 key and its structure.
tools: built-in browser (ANOM IIIF/IIP images, canvas crops)

solution.what: Opened the FranceArchives record for f. 88, found the ANOM IIIF manifest and the IIP image URL; direct curl of the image gets 403, the browser pane loads it (no proof-of-work bypass).
Transcribed the 12 cipher lines of f. 88 from 640x360 crops, digit by digit: 181 groups, 109 distinct, values 1-845, full-stop separated.
Range and frequency: 28 groups above 696 and 17 above 800, top groups 361 x9, 587 x5, 110 x5, 817 x5, 23 x5, 270 x4; IC 0.0088. Range excludes the 1761 code (max 696).
Applied the mercier1761 key (key1761.tsv, 201 values, max 696): 39 of 181 tokens valued, output word salad.
Applied the 1765 d'Ennery form (key1765_ennery.tsv, 800 entries): 164 of 181 valued, all nonsense; 17 groups above its maximum.
Looked for neighbouring clear letters: f. 87 (no. 237, same date) is clear, a request for the inspection of the Dominica hospitals; read at low resolution only.
Opened catalogue 1203's sample letter C8 A 78 f. 123 (no. 363, 11 Oct 1779): it carries a contemporary interlinear decipherment above every group (the catalogue note said none was seen).
Transcribed the 104 groups of f. 123 with their interlinear clear syllables in 800x450 crops (pairs1779_f123.txt).
Aligned the pairs: 77 code groups with values (now key_bouille.tsv); readings include 361 de, 587 la, 381 des, 303 troupes, 270+44+398 Cette, 309+12+754+162 moitié, 428 la Guadeloupe, 631 deffen(se).
Same-code test between f. 88 and f. 123: 42 of 109 distinct groups shared; 10 shared adjacent pairs and 2 shared triples against means 1.55 and 0.01 after 2000 shuffles of the 1778 order (p < 0.001).

Applied key1779.tsv to f. 88: 90 of 181 tokens (49.7%) valued; coherent stretches 'l'état de la [694] des troupes' (with 250 = l', 5 = at), 'Cette ... isle ... est', 'moitié'; the rest valued groups are function words, 91 tokens unvalued.
Tentative values from context, not entered in the key: 250 = l', 5 = at, 191 = j', 815 = is or ment, giving 'de ce mois, j'attends' on line 2.
No ciphertext-only anneal run: the mercier1761 control (same shape, ~800 entries, 818 tokens) recovered 5-9% and the truth outscored the found key; 181 tokens is smaller.
No new web search on this target in this session (catalogue sweep of 28 Oct found nothing published).

Survey of the first image(s): interlinear decipherment present on C8 A 78 f.3, f.5, f.31, f.144 (and f.123); none on f.1 (note 'duplicata ... déchiffrée'), C8 A 79 f.19, f.70, C8 A 77 f.101 (pure cipher); clear first image on C8 A 79 f.4, f.24, C8 A 81 f.97, f.104; C8 A 81 f.114 clear opening with cipher lines under it (not read); f.101 image 0163 is a table of cipher groups in two columns.

Paired f.3 lines 1-2 and about 60 groups of f.31 (lines 1-3 and further lines read off 0.8-scale crops) in pairs1779_f3_f31.txt; alignments through ink bleed-through on f.31 partly uncertain; conflicts kept (67 qua/vous, 503 par/e, 305 se/e, 718 a/a, 185 es/ez).

Merged all pairs into key_bouille.tsv (123 groups, provenance per value): new values include 694 situation, 267 la Martinique, 636 au, 104 1er, 116 ma, 325 rs, 508 pi, 78 ho, 417 ta, 453 cents, 91 x, 709 si, 37 hommes, 558 recrue, 268 garnison, 682 dont, 815 is, 250 l', 287 etat, 837 honneur.

Applied the extended key to f.88: 123 of 181 tokens (68.0%) valued, 61 of 109 distinct groups; the reading is a monthly troop return: l'etat de la situation des troupes au 1er de ce mois ... garnison de la Martinique ... cents ... hommes ... hopital ... la Guadeloupe ... troupes.

Strict sense proxy (measure_sense.py: valued stretches cut at unvalued groups, fr-gutenberg word list + declared additions): 105 of 181 tokens (58.0%) fall inside dictionary words. The proxy accepts word-shaped strings, so it overstates reading; not the 95% bar.

Tentative values from contexts that parallel f.123/f.31 (tentative.tsv): 5 = at (l'et-at), 538 = fe and 614 = f ('hommes ef-fe-c-ti-f-s' = effectifs; f.123 has 594 658 345 754 for ef fe c ti). With them 128 of 181 (70.7%) valued. Not in the key.

f.101 (5 Dec 1778) opens with the phrase of f.88 lines 1-2: 208 250 837 361 57 147 1 250 287 361 694 381 303 361 267 636 104 361 270 309 815 = [J'ai] l'honneur de vous envoy-er l'etat de la situation des troupes de la Martinique au 1er de ce mois; the next monthly return in the same code (not yet transcribed).

Paired the interlinear decipherments of C8 A 78 f.31 (rest, both images), f.3 (images 0004-0006), f.5 (0007) and f.144 (0233) with subagents reading 0.8-1.0 scale crops: about 1450 group readings from f.3/f.31 (365 distinct pairs) and about 325 from f.5/f.144 (pairs1779_f3_f31_more.txt, pairs1779_f5_f144.txt). Arks found: f.5 zn401yssvxxy, f.144 zn401qkkpmkw.

Tested the LLM key-editor fills of research/keyedit (Test 4/5) against the new pairs. Of the fills on groups that occur in the pairs, the two first Sonnet runs were right on 12 and wrong on 17; the later Haiku/Sonnet/held-out runs right on 1 of 20. Independently confirmed: 103=u, 665=pa, 531=autant, 5=at, 491=an, 321=pas, 402=di; wrong: 545 (it, not trois/men), 195 (ni), 272 (i), 320 (mi), 412 (du), 443 (y), 454 (mille), 516 (tro), 622 (ces), 845 (ga). 619, 667, 495, 26, 260, 509, 138, 710 do not occur in any paired letter. 46 reads aux twice and avec? twice: open.

Merged the f.31, f.3, f.5 and f.144 pairs into key_bouille.tsv (123 -> 346 groups) and re-applied it to f.88: 166 of 181 tokens valued (91.7%, was 68.0%), strict sense proxy 85.6% (was 58.0%); text reads as the monthly troop return with garrison 3300 men, Martinique/Guadeloupe halves. Conflicts 46 aux/avec and 12 i/e unresolved.

Read 13 of the 14 open f.88 groups from word frames (impatience, ministre de la marine, vuide, permet, entreprendre, pouvant, verrai, fournie, tant en troupes réglées): 667 im, 495 minist, 710 marine, 568 i, 809 per, 146 entre, 619 va, 481 suffisante, 509 ra, 260 i, 645 fo, 819 tant, 26 gl. None occurs in a paired letter, so none is checked; kept in tentative.tsv, not in the key. 138 stays open.

Transcribed C8 A 77 f.101 image 0162 (6 lines, cipher only) and decoded it with the key: reads as the same return plus garrison of the newly taken colony and 'les travaux ... approchent de leur fin'. Second frame for 619=va and 103=u (travaux); gives 138 = la Dominique, 577 = tra, 678 = fin, 208 = j'ai by context. Not interlinear, so these stay tentative.

Image check of f.31 (0046 l.7) and f.101 0163: 46 = avec (gloss 'auec'; 'aux l'escadre' ungrammatical), 12 = i; 645 = fo confirmed by the f.101 table header 'fournie par les garnisons de la Martinique et la Guadeloupe'; 138 = la Dominique from the same header. Pair files corrected, key regenerated.

Transcribed the f.101 enclosure table (image 0163): header repeats the f.88 garrison sentence; rows decode as unit names and figures. Number words (quarante) give 819 = qu and 73 = ar, replacing the f.88 guess 819 = tant; 279 now doubtful (single 'pri?' in f.31 vs 'cent [279]-ante sept' in the table).

Paired the rest of f.144 (images 0234-0246, 13 pages, 275 lines, two agents) and merged: key_bouille.tsv 346 -> 507 groups; f.88 175/181 tokens valued from interlinear (96.7%), strict proxy 92.8%. Context readings tested: held 809 per, 146 entre, 619 va, 138 la Dominique, 645 fo, 577 tra; corrected 710 guerre (not marine), 509 rai, 819 soit (not qu), 279 non (not pri), 73 not ar.

Applied the 507-value key to the cipher-only letter C8 A 79 f.19 (no. 23, 14 Nov 1780; 157 groups transcribed by agent from image 0029): 147 groups valued (93.6%), reads as a provisions return ('subsistances ... magasins du roi ... du commerce ... situation toujours infiniment précaire'). No interlinear gloss exists for this letter.

Applied the key to the cipher-only letter C8 A 79 f.70 (no. 415, 24 May 1780; 190 groups from image 0107): 182 valued (95.8%), troop return for Martinique, Dominica, Grenada and St Vincent, 'il manque au régiment de la Martinique ... pour le mettre au complet ... lui faire passer des recrues'. Blue-pencil gloss on the last two lines agrees.

Applied the key to the cipher blocks of C8 A 81 f.114-116 (no. 12, 24 Nov 1782; 1297 groups from images 0195-0203, two translation-slip pages partly hidden): 1244 valued (95.9%), reads as a defence letter (colonies in état de défense, garrison states, Grenade/Guadeloupe/St-Christophe, 'ma présence devenant inutile ici'). Confirms 26 = gl in 'troupes réglées' and 481 = suffisante. C8 A 78 f.1 (Chiffre de 1777, Grasse) is a different code the key does not read.

Used the f.19, f.70, f.114 readings to settle the key conflicts: 25 = meme, 345 = c, 103 = u, 307 = ba; 260 = incessamment fits f.70 and f.88 (context). Checked 538 on the f.88 image: reads 538 clearly, yet the f.101 table needs 538 = sept; f.88 'ef 538 c ti f s' needs fe (f.123 has 658) so 538 is polyphonic or a slip.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1748 tokens, 322 types, fr-modern order 4: reading -1.987 per letter; random keys -3.129 (z 10.6); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -2.222 (mean -2.245, z 12.6); annealer on the real text -2.164. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.987; polyphony 0.0; 77 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.164

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: Key for Bouillé's code (507 groups, values to 845) read off the interlinear glosses of five 1779 letters in the same series (C8 A 78 ff. 123, 3, 5, 31, 144); applied to three cipher-only letters of 1780-1782 with no gloss: 182 of 190, 147 of 157 and 1,244 of 1,297 groups valued (95.8%, 93.6%, 95.9%), and checked statistically on f. 88, f. 70, f. 19 and f. 114 together.
outcome.notes: Read in part. The three new letters read as French sentences with scattered holes (clean-sentence share 0.80-0.86); f. 88 and f. 101 of the same key were read first by Brice Dudout (bouille1778) and are not republished here; 5 groups of f. 88 occur in no gloss; 538 is polyphonic or a slip; f. 1 (Grasse, Chiffre de 1777) is another code; MAR/G/178 and the minutes C8 A 77 ff. 31, 43 need a visit.

gaps.detail: none occurs in a glossed letter; all glossed letters (f. 3, 5, 31, 123, 144) are paired; context readings only

texts.summary: Return of provisions in the king's and the merchants' stores on 1 November 1780: the situation is precarious, new supplies must come lest the colony be forced to buy for itself, the merchants' stores slightly refilled by two ships of the convoy and a neutral.
texts.note: 3 Nov 2026: share of cipher groups valued from interlinear pairs; context readings and unvalued groups in brackets.

texts.summary: Troop return for Martinique, Dominica and Grenada, Saint Vincent's return of April only, du Montet's of May still missing; Bouillé will send 400-500 men to Grenada, and the Martinique regiment is 359 men short and needs recruits.
texts.note: 3 Nov 2026: share of cipher groups valued from interlinear pairs; context readings and unvalued groups in brackets.

texts.summary: Defence letter at the end of 1782: all colonies in a state of defence with six months' food, only 2,000 regulars left on Martinique, ships sent to cruise off Barbados to cover the convoy from New England and the arriving squadron, despatches for Trinidad; the writer says his presence will be useless if he is not employed in the coming operations.
